preventive_actions.action: Implement enhanced respiratory protection measures (e.g., N95/FFP2 masks, improved ventilation)
Ensure regular training on biological hazards and safe work practices
Provide access to appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)

sources_or_basis: ERBio general questionnaire responses (40 Yes, 8 No)
Exposure information: Frequent occupational exposure to SARS-CoV-2
reasoning_summary: SARS-CoV-2 (BIO-VIR-0064) identified with frequent exposure. Compliance rate of 83.33% (40/48) indicates high adherence to controls. Probability of exposure is high (83%). GRB classified as Group 3 (high-risk biological agent). Risk class determined as High based on exposure frequency and compliance metrics. Preventive actions focus on respiratory protection and PPE given the airborne transmission nature of SARS-CoV-2.
